evidence.activity: Practice management, business transition and marketing/growth services for independent financial advisors, bundled into the company's fees
evidence.quote: We help advisors manage and grow their businesses by offering consultative practice management services, including access to our business transition services, case management expertise, third-party applications, thought leadership, and marketing and growth programs.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Business segments overview > Investment Advisors

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: a growth service for advisor-clients' businesses, but it is an ordinary fee-bundled B2B offering, not aimed at small-business or founder barriers, and the segment is moving toward larger enterprise RIAs

evidence.activity: Outsourced fund operations for investment managers of all sizes, including emerging and start-up managers
evidence.quote: Our outsourcing solutions across the front-to-back office with best-in-breed technology accommodate investment managers of all sizes and complexities and enables them to focus on core business activities—from the unique needs of emerging and start-up managers to the complex needs of global, multi-asset hybrid managers.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Business segments overview > Investment Managers

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: start-up managers are served as ordinary customers, with no specific enabling program for them

creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers financial technology, operations and asset management and shows no creative activity.

community.reason: Level 1 based only on general language ('make an impact on our communities'); coverage is insufficient under condition 2 because the human capital and corporate sustainability discussion is under about 150 words and describes no specific activity.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 1 based only on general values language ('welcome diverse perspectives to foster an inclusive environment'); coverage is insufficient under condition 2 because the relevant workforce discussion is under about 150 words.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: advisors and start-up managers are served as customers, but there is no specific enabling service aimed at founder or small-business barriers (torn between 1 and 2, so the lower level was chosen).

ai.notes: Community and Cross-cultural are marked insufficient, which triggers the automated second look using the company's sustainability report. Items treated as traps or excluded: 'customer education' (a client function, not company education); 'higher education' and 'not-for-profit organizations' (institutional clients only); 'foundation' in MD&A (used metaphorically); 'diversified portfolios'; 'product innovation'; the Global Capability Center in India (international operations alone do not count); and investments in new businesses (the company's own R&D). Stratos 'advisor-enablement' and succession-planning capabilities serve advisor businesses but give no specific founder or small-business enabling program and no reach figures, so they are not scored above 1. The FCA remediation matter involving SIEL is not relevant to the themes.
